description: Push leads into a connected destination: 'close' (CRM — uses the account's saved field mapping), 'ghl' (GoHighLevel sub-account), 'google_sheets' (new spreadsheet, or pass spreadsheet_id for one LeadMarina created before), or a file — 'csv' | 'xlsx' | 'json' (a 7-day download link, also emailed to the account owner when the file is small enough to attach). Exports EITHER one search's leads (pass search_id) or the whole library (set all=true). Either can be narrowed with the same filter rows as query_leads — with search_id they apply within that search. Leads go out best-ranked first (rank, then id), the order of the leads table. LIMITS PER CALL, which differ by destination because CRMs take one API call per lead: csv/xlsx 50,000 · json 25,000 · google_sheets 5,000 · close/ghl 1,000. For a big library going to a CRM, export csv and import the file instead. If more leads match than the limit, the response sets truncated=true and returns next_cursor — relay that to the user, the export was partial; to send the next batch, call export_leads again with the SAME destination, search_id or all, and filters, plus cursor=next_cursor. A next_cursor with not_sent means the destination's time limit cut this batch short: the same call with that cursor sends the rest. An all=true export spread over several calls reads the library live, so a lead that a search running between calls finds again can be skipped or sent twice; for one consistent copy, export the library in a single csv/xlsx (up to 50,000 leads) or json (up to 25,000) call while no search is running. Close, GoHighLevel and a LeadMarina-created sheet passed as spreadsheet_id UPDATE previously exported leads in place (matched by Google CID), never touching the user's own CRM notes/columns; a file or a new sheet is a fresh copy every time — so do not repeat a call that succeeded.

all.description: Export the whole library instead of one search.

cursor.description: Continue an export: the next_cursor a previous export_leads call returned. Pass it with the same search_id/all and filters.

filters.description: Optional query_leads-style filter rows: within the search when search_id is given, across the library with all=true.

spreadsheet_id.description: google_sheets only: add to this existing LeadMarina-created sheet instead of a new one.

name: export_leads

data_sources.description: Where the sources, licences and notices are for emails and owner names that may come from open datasets and public records. Pass it on with any of this data you share.

file.description: File exports only: the file name.

limit.description: The per-call limit that applied, when truncated.

next_cursor.description: Present when the per-call limit or this call's time limit left matching leads unsent: pass it as cursor, with the same destination, search_id/all and filters, to send them. It does not offer again a lead the destination refused (counted as failed in outcome).

not_sent.description: Leads of this batch the destination's time limit did not reach.

truncated.description: True when more leads matched than this destination's limit — the export was PARTIAL.

warning.description: Present when the per-call limit or this call's time limit left leads unsent: what happened and how to send them. Leads the destination refused are not covered here — outcome counts them as failed.

title: Export leads to a destination
